sections.changelog:
1.69.83 - interactive premium profiles

  • Premium professional profiles gain: video-meeting booking (direct link from the CMS or a wired lead-request form), an inline AI advisor answering questions about the profession (premium feature), an activity-area mini map, live profile-view counter, and clickable specialty chips that search the directory.

1.69.82 - world-class professional profiles

  • Professional pages get a rich profile: brand monogram portrait, verified badge, rating, experience stats, specialties/languages/areas chips, bio, their projects on the site, and profession-matched guides and tools. New professions added: interior designers, engineers, tax accountants, surveyors, property managers, urban planners.

1.69.81 - rebrand sweep

  • The old brand name is removed everywhere (SEO titles, meta descriptions, schemas, concierge, emails, OG images, engine strings). Site name is now: נדלן.

1.69.80 - typography sweep + brand favicon

  • Article headings and body text now share alignment (start), measure and the brand serif across the site - no more justified body against misaligned fallback-font headings.
  • New crisp SVG favicon matching the logo: ink isometric tower on cream with the single gold rule. Replaces the off-brand blue-gold house in modern browsers.

1.69.79 - project page order

  • Apartment selector and the rich live map move up directly under the 3D tour; the duplicate basic map section is hidden. Chat launcher fully removed (config).

1.69.78 - one compact contact bar

  • Project pages: the stacked floating pile (two full-width pills, duplicate WhatsApp bubble, chat button) becomes ONE compact two-button contact bar. Accessibility button untouched.

1.69.77 - project buying experience

  • Every project page gets a sticky section nav, a working click-a-floor apartment selector with real unit data, price estimates and instant WhatsApp/call, a live clickable surroundings map (streets/satellite, real schools/transit/shops, and purple markers for nearby urban-renewal plans linking to their pages), a hub-spoke info grid (developer, professionals, calculators, guides), and a factual intro strip.
  • 3D model: pinch zoom-out unlocked (max field-of-view 44 to 68 degrees) so buyers can see the whole building on mobile.

1.69.76 - clean floating layer + working project contact rail

  • Removes the floating golden chat button that stacked over the action rail and the accessibility button on project pages.
  • Project buyer journey: site WhatsApp and phone are now configured, so the call/WhatsApp contact actions on Ashira, Rainbow and Dimri showrooms are live.

1.69.75 - default facade for all + listings SEO

  • Every listing now renders the interactive building facade, even when building data was not provided (sensible schematic default).
  • Properties archive gets a proper Hebrew SEO title (replaces the internal English label), and every listing auto-generates a data-driven meta description.

1.69.74 - listing gaps closed vs competitive teardown

  • Click the highlighted apartment on the building facade to step inside to its floor plan (slice inspect), with a back-to-building link.
  • Live area map upgraded: streets/satellite layer switcher and real POI markers (schools, kindergartens, transit, shops, health) from OpenStreetMap around the exact address.
  • "What is special" highlights section (AI-generated in the wizard, editable before publish).
  • Trust row: last-updated date, native share, report-a-mistake.

1.69.73 - listing gallery front-end unblock

  • The front-end tier strip no longer removes the photo gallery or appends the pro-upgrade box on free property listings (second enforcement point missed in 1.69.72).

1.69.72 - free listings show photos

  • Property listings always show their photo gallery and contact form; paid-tier photo gating now applies only to the professionals/projects directory it was designed for.

1.69.71 - listing city/neighborhood meta

  • Registers city + neighborhood meta on properties (queried by similar-listings, needed by the wizard and REST seeding).

1.69.70 - World-class property listings + free AI listing wizard

  • Single property pages get a key-facts hero (price, rooms, floor, sqm, price/sqm), a selectable sketch facade (the listed apartment highlighted in the building, with an inside floor-plan view), a monthly-costs panel (mortgage estimate, arnona, vaad bayit) and a location map. Works with the existing schools/transit, similar-listings, gallery and schema modules.
  • New free listing wizard at /post-listing/: describe the property in your own words, AI builds the listing, you review, upload photos, submit for quick moderation. Login required, rate-limited, strict sanitization.
  • Demo showcase listings are flagged and kept out of search engines.

1.69.69 - Project magazine cards

  • Redesigns the project archive cards (/projects/) to the "Quiet Luxury" magazine layout: 4:3 hero image, project-type chip, serif name with city, a clean stat row (units / floors / status from real data only), and a full-width call-to-action. Scoped to project cards; the professionals directory is unchanged.

1.69.68 - Root cause H1 clipping fix + poisoned ZIP rebuild

  • Overrides WordPress core .is-layout-constrained max-width:760px !important rule that was clipping the homepage/project H1 and hero sections on home + project pages.
  • Unclips and mobile-scales the home hero H1, prevents horizontal scroll on mobile.
  • Rebuilt the release ZIP with the canonical forward-slash builder after the previous 1.69.68 ZIP shipped with Windows backslash paths (would have jammed the uPress plugin manager, see M3).

1.69.67 - uPress CSS bypass

  • Injects emergency layout CSS from nadlan-config so homepage thumbnails, showroom stage height, and floating controls can deploy even when uPress blocks active child-theme Git sync.

1.69.66 - Stage 1 visual gate hardening

  • Removes public WooCommerce fragments/notices from project and sitemap surfaces, rebuilds/noindexes the HTML sitemap when needed, and strips public comment/post-navigation leftovers from project pages.
  • Shows loud, visible Mapbox/model/facade error states instead of silent fallbacks; concept facade images are labeled as not official material and no fake unit grid renders without a genuine CMS facade.
  • Contains the mobile showroom surface to prevent horizontal scrolling at 390px and preserves clean UTF-8 Hebrew mobile action labels.

1.69.65 - 3D map + sketch-first showroom (Antigravity, cleaned)

  • Neighborhood map is now tilted 3D (Zillow-style): pitch 45, and a fill-extrusion layer that raises real building heights. Showroom is sketch-first: if a project has no 3D model, it starts in facade/sketch view and omits the empty model-viewer + the 3D toggle, so a sketch-only project never looks broken.

1.69.64 - Showroom control panel (no more Custom Fields)

  • Adds a normal settings box on the Project edit screen: an 'Enable showroom' checkbox plus fields for map coordinates, sketch/poster URL and optional 3D model URL. Writes the same meta the engine already reads (nlp3d_use_engine, lat, lng, project_model_poster, project_model_glb), so projects can be configured without touching Custom Fields or secret keys. Nonce + capability + coordinate validation.

1.69.63 - non-binding purchase offer (LOI) form, buyer-journey

  • Adds the [nadlan_loi_form] shortcode: a buyer submits a non-binding purchase offer (name, ID, phone, email, optional offer price, mortgage status) on a project/unit. The offer is saved as a real lead through the existing lead pipeline (dedupe + routing) with a direct-insert fallback so no offer is ever lost, and LOI-specific data (offer price, mortgage status, unit) is stored as lead meta. Styled to the design system.

1.69.62 - bulk SEO template for the long-tail project catalog

  • Added a real-data-only title/meta template for nadlan_project pages that were falling back to WordPress's bare default title (post title + site name, no buyer intent). Runs at low priority so hand-written titles (Rainbow, Ashira) are untouched. Uses the post's own title and its real nadlan_city term if set -- never invents a city, price, or unit count.

1.69.61 - real Madlan geo coordinates (replaces placeholder seed)

  • Ashira, Rainbow and Dimri Yama now carry their real, verified Madlan-sourced map coordinates (one-time migration on plugin load, runs once). Previously Ashira used a generic placeholder and Rainbow/Dimri Yama had none at all, so their map marker never rendered correctly.

1.69.60 - PR7: visible FAQ accordion on project pages

  • Renders the project FAQ as an accessible accordion in the About section, from the same CMS meta the FAQ rich-result already uses (no duplicate structured data). Shows only when the project has real FAQ entries; hidden otherwise.

1.69.59 - PR6: interior tour (lazy, real assets only)

  • Adds an interior-tour block in the media section, wired into the existing engine (no second renderer). A 360 tour iframe lazy-loads only on click (page stays fast); 360 panoramas mount Pannellum on demand; if a project has no real tour assets it shows an honest placeholder (no fake walkthrough). Editable per project via CMS meta project_3d_tour_url / project_interior_panoramas.

1.69.58 - PR5: price + comps section (real data, honest)

  • Adds a price & estimate section (with its own nav item) showing a non-binding RANGE + source + date, and a comparable-sales table built only from real recorded transactions; if a project has none wired it shows an honest pending state (never sample rows). Ashira is seeded with real Madlan/Tax-Authority figures (avg and recorded sales) and Sde Dov coordinates so the map marker sits on land.

1.69.57 - PR4: one in-page section nav (no stacked nav rows)

  • The project page header is trimmed to brand + language bar, and a single sticky section nav (building / apartments / surroundings / media / info) with scroll-spy replaces the duplicate nav row. The price item is intentionally deferred to the next release (its section does not exist yet).

1.69.56 - Project catalog route cleanup

  • Redirects the obsolete showroom prototype home.html route to the real /projects/ catalog, while keeping the existing homepage project band and catalog archive intact.

1.69.55 - Real language links in showroom footer

  • The showroom footer language links now point to the real sibling language pages instead of #, while the header language buttons and click handler keep navigating to the same crawlable URLs. Includes live browser proof for HE/EN/FR/RU/AR desktop and mobile.

1.69.54 - CRITICAL FIX: restore the project article

  • The 1.69.52 de-stack removed the whole page body, including the SEO article (it was inside the same block as the old showroom). This keeps the article (all languages) and drops only the duplicate showroom, with a guard so the body can never be blanked again. No content was ever lost from the database.

1.69.53 - One-click language switch + styled article

  • The language buttons now open the matching language page (each language is its own real, crawlable page) instead of doing nothing; the page opens in its own language; languages without a page are hidden.
  • Adds hreflang tags so Google serves the right language.
  • The project article now uses the cream/gold editorial styling (a dedicated stylesheet).
  • Fixes a stray untranslated direction label on English pages.

1.69.52 - De-stack the project page (one showroom, styled article)

  • Removes the duplicate baked static showroom from the project body so only the new engine renders (no more triple-stacked page).
  • Styles the project SEO article in the cream/gold editorial system (readable column, serif headings, gold accents).

1.69.51 - Restore the detailed Ashira model

  • Point the Ashira model field at the detailed Claude Design model (ashira.glb) instead of the crude box massing; re-seed overwrites the box. Illustrative until official BIM.

1.69.50 - Full-bleed showroom (fidelity)

  • The showroom engine now breaks out of the theme constrained content column to full viewport width, so it renders like the full-page design instead of a cramped narrow box.

1.69.49 - Grounded Ashira model deployed

  • Ships the grounded Ashira massing model (real 8/8/16/35 Avisror composition) and seeds it into the project model field if empty, so the hero is no longer an empty box. Illustrative until official BIM; editable in the project.

1.69.47 - New engine on all Ashira language pages

  • The new showroom engine now renders on the Ashira HE/EN/FR/RU/AR pages (the homepage linked to the English page, which still showed the old showroom).

1.69.46 - New showroom engine ON for Ashira

  • The new showroom engine now renders automatically on the Ashira project page (no manual setting). Other projects unchanged. Reversible via the nadlan_showroom_engine_default_on filter.

1.69.45 - Showroom engine: real Mapbox + crash-safe map block

  • NEW: real Mapbox map (project + nearby project markers) when a Mapbox token is set; stylized map stays as graceful fallback.
  • FIX: the complete-world map block now renders safely for any project (added area/center/content payload + defensive guards).

1.69.44 - Showroom engine: safe per-project swap

  • NEW: set post meta nlp3d_use_engine=1 (or option nadlan_showroom_engine_enable=1) to render the new showroom engine on a project page instead of the old showroom. Default off, reversible, no stacking.

1.69.43 - Showroom engine: live CMS data

  • NEW: the [nadlan_showroom_engine] shortcode now renders any project from its own CMS fields (auto-detects the current project page, or id/slug). page="home" builds the gallery from all published projects. Featured projects rank first.

1.69.42 - Showroom engine bridge (preview)

  • NEW: data-driven showroom engine ported from the design system, mounted via the [nadlan_showroom_engine] shortcode for safe preview on a draft page. Does not change existing project pages.

1.69.41 - Premium showroom grid

  • UX: moves the project controls into the real stage and turns the selected apartment card into a desktop side panel after selection, matching the Lovable premium showroom pattern without adding a second CSS layer.
  • UX: keeps the building full width before selection, then switches to a stage-plus-panel layout when a buyer selects a unit.
  • HEALTH: project_3d reports premium_showroom_grid_v16941 for live verification.

1.69.40 - Real model scene source

  • FIX: stops the decorative scene grid from drawing behind a real building model, so Rainbow shows one visual source instead of a picture over a drawing.
  • FIX: raises desktop showroom toolbar buttons to 44px minimum touch targets.
  • HEALTH: project_3d reports real_model_scene_truth_v16940 and desktop_toolbar_touch_v16940 for live verification.

1.69.39 - Mobile toolbar touch targets

  • FIX: limits the mobile showroom toolbar to four view controls so every visible control keeps a 44px tap target inside the narrow model column.
  • FIX: hides zoom and facade restore controls on mobile where they cannot fit safely.
  • HEALTH: project_3d reports mobile_toolbar_touch_v16939 for live verification.

1.69.38 - Mobile toolbar containment

  • FIX: changes the mobile showroom toolbar to a fixed seven-slot grid so all controls fit inside 390px without horizontal scroll.
  • UX: shortens visible control labels while keeping full Hebrew aria labels for accessibility.
  • HEALTH: project_3d reports mobile_toolbar_grid_v16938 for live verification.

1.69.37 - Mobile showroom control polish

  • FIX: keeps the mobile showroom controls in one horizontal row instead of stacking over the building view.
  • FIX: removes the selected-apartment title separator that could render as a stray dot on 390px screens.
  • UX: tightens selected-card mobile typography and chips while preserving 44px tap targets.
  • HEALTH: project_3d reports mobile_toolbar_card_polish_v16937 for live verification.

1.69.36 - Single showroom selection surface

  • FIX: removes the duplicate apartment console from the active Rainbow showroom render path so the selected apartment appears in one buyer-facing card instead of two competing interfaces.
  • FIX: keeps the working model click path while adding null guards for the removed floor, unit and detail controls.
  • UX: makes the premium showroom a single vertical cream flow and keeps toolbar controls at a 44px minimum tap target.
  • HEALTH: project_3d reports single_selection_surface_v16936 for live verification.

1.69.35 - Showroom mobile touch targets

  • FIX: raises the premium showroom mobile toolbar, apartment markers and selected-card close control to 44px touch targets after live QA found 30-42px controls.
  • QA: requires fresh 1280 and 390 screenshots proving selected apartment, camera target, no overflow and no buyer-facing internal language.

1.69.34 - Premium showroom visual source

  • UX: the project showroom now loads the Lovable premium cream stylesheet as the primary visual source.
  • FIX: removes the extra plugin poster and intro sections from the showroom render path so the page no longer stacks duplicate showroom openings.
  • HEALTH: project_3d reports premium_showroom_stylesheet_v16934 and duplicate_showroom_intro_disabled_v16934 for live verification.

1.69.33 - Showroom poster reveal fix

  • FIX: the building preview image now stays on screen until the 3D building has actually rendered, removing the blank flash on page refresh where the preview vanished before the model appeared.
  • CHANGE: the 3D view reveals on manual control after the first painted frame instead of dismissing the preview the moment the file finished downloading.

1.69.32 - Mobile row-aligned model taps

  • FIX: mobile model-surface taps now prefer a row-aligned authored apartment target before a looser neighboring-unit guess.

  • QA: requires live Rainbow desktop and 390px screenshots proving marker taps and raw model-surface taps select and move the camera.

1.69.31 - Desktop model tap fallback

  • FIX: desktop and mobile model-surface taps now reject distant mesh guesses and fall back to the closer visible apartment target when the GLB hit is not reliable.
  • UX: increases the visible apartment target fallback radius so buyer taps near authored unit markers are easier to select without changing the unit-map data.
  • QA: requires live Rainbow desktop and 390px screenshots proving visible apartment taps and raw model-surface tap behavior.

1.69.30 - Showroom wording and mobile model-tap fallback

  • FIX: mobile model-surface taps now reject distant mesh guesses and fall back to the closer visible apartment target when the GLB hit is not reliable.
  • CONTENT: removes remaining buyer-facing model wording from the project showroom controls, missing-asset copy and selected-unit context.
  • QA: requires live Rainbow desktop and 390px screenshots with selected units and raw model-surface tap proof.

1.69.29 - Cream Projects archive skin

  • UX: Projects archive hero, filters and cards now use the cream editorial system instead of the old dark gradient skin.
  • FIX: removes active dark archive hero and card-media sources rather than layering a late cream override.
  • QA: requires live /projects/ desktop and 390px screenshots after deploy.

1.69.28 - Mobile Projects archive viewport

  • FIX: Projects archive now prints a mobile viewport meta tag so /projects/ renders at the device width instead of a desktop-scaled archive on 390px screens.
  • CONTENT: removes em dash punctuation from the directory archive file.

1.69.27 - Mobile model surface unit scoring

  • FIX: model surface taps now prefer authored units that are horizontally close to the mesh hit before scoring floor height.
  • FIX: prevents a low mobile raw tap on the main tower from jumping to the distant boutique unit only because its height was slightly closer.
  • QA: requires live Rainbow desktop and 390px mesh-pick screenshots with the expected unit selected.

1.69.26 - Model surface mesh-pick first

  • FIX: keeps marker buttons working, but prevents mobile raw surface taps from being counted as mesh proof when only the marker fallback ran.
  • QA: requires live Rainbow desktop and 390px mesh-pick screenshots with mesh-pick logs before calling the selection path fixed.

1.69.25 - Raw model surface apartment selection

  • FIX: raw buyer taps on the model surface now reach the model-viewer mesh-pick path when the tap is not already handled by a visible apartment marker.

  • QA: requires fresh Rainbow desktop and 390px mesh-pick screenshots before owner activation.

1.69.24 - Reliable showroom apartment taps

  • FIX: delayed camera refreshes are cancelled when a newer unit is selected, preventing the selected card and camera target from drifting apart.
  • QA: requires fresh Rainbow desktop and 390px mobile tap-grid screenshots before owner activation.

  • FIX: selected apartment camera now re-applies the target and triggers delayed model-viewer repaints so the desktop GLB appears inside the normal buyer interaction window.
  • QA: requires live desktop and 390px screenshots after selecting unit 16, with visible model and no public-language leaks.

1.69.22 - Selected model repaint

  • FIX: selected apartment camera changes now trigger a controlled model-viewer repaint, keeping the desktop GLB visible after a buyer selects unit 16.
  • QA: requires live desktop and 390px screenshots showing the selected unit, selected marker, camera target and visible real model.

1.69.21 - Desktop model selection visibility

  • QA: requires live desktop and 390px screenshots showing unit 16 selected with the real model still visible.

1.69.20 - Selected model camera settle

  • FIX: selected apartment camera changes now reapply after model-viewer processes the new orbit and target, preventing the desktop model from disappearing after a buyer selects a unit.

1.69.19 - Selected model target units

  • QA: requires live desktop and 390px screenshots showing the model remains visible after selecting unit 16.

1.69.18 - Desktop selected model camera framing

  • UX: mobile keeps the existing auto camera behavior because the 390px selected view already frames correctly.
  • QA: requires live desktop and 390px screenshots before and after selecting unit 16.

  • UX: Rainbow now opens with the full building overview instead of auto-focusing the first available apartment.
  • FIX: stored unit memory no longer crops the first showroom view before the buyer chooses a unit.
  • QA: requires desktop and 390px screenshots before and after selecting an apartment.

1.69.16 - Real model surface apartment pick
